capabilities.name: Book a restaurant table
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent find an open table and book it, or hand you off to finish the booking?

US.note: Google AI Mode finds real-time slots on OpenTable, Resy and Tock for all US users without Labs, and since August 2026 ChatGPT finds bookable tables through OpenTable, Resy and Yelp on all plans.

evidence.title: Explore new ways to plan and book travel with AI in Search

GB.note: Google AI Mode books UK tables through TheFork, SevenRooms, ResDiary, OpenTable and others (the final step is on the partner site), and ChatGPT reservations work through OpenTable and the TheFork app.

evidence.title: Booking restaurants in the UK just got easier with AI in Search

ChatGPT aceita reservas de restaurantes (TheFork app, first markets include UK)

capabilities.name: Order food, groceries or rides
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent order food, groceries or a ride for you?

US.note: The DoorDash app in ChatGPT builds grocery carts from US retailers for checkout on DoorDash, and Uber's apps in ChatGPT, shown only to US users, request on-demand rides and find Uber Eats restaurants, then hand off to the Uber apps to pay.

evidence.title: DoorDash Launches Grocery Shopping App Within ChatGPT
ChatGPT Integration for Rides
ChatGPT Integration for Eaters

GB.note: Just Eat's AI assistant in its iOS and Android apps, first a chat assistant and since January 2026 also a voice assistant (launched first in the UK), takes requests such as "order my usual Friday night curry" and fills the basket for checkout in the app; Just Eat ordering through Alexa+ was announced in March 2026 but no launch was found, no Deliveroo agent was found, and the Uber Eats app in ChatGPT is US-only.

evidence.title: Introducing the next evolution of ordering: Just Eat Takeaway.com unveils AI-voice assistant (launching first in the UK)
Just Eat Takeaway.com launches AI Voice Assistant across Europe (after UK and Germany launches; can fill the basket and order your usual)
DID SOMEBODY SAY…. "Alexa, what's for dinner"? (Just Eat ordering on Alexa+ in the UK, launching soon)
ChatGPT Integration for Eaters

DE.note: Lieferando, Just Eat Takeaway.com's German brand, has had an AI chat assistant in its app since April 2025 that takes orders, and the group's voice assistant, which fills the basket for checkout, reached Germany in 2026 after the UK; Wolt's newsroom shows no AI agent, and the Uber Eats app in ChatGPT is US-only.

repos.name: Swiggy MCP Server

repos.name: OSRM
repos.role: Fast routing engine on OpenStreetMap that ride and delivery apps use to find routes, travel times and the best order of stops.

repos.name: Valhalla
repos.role: Routing engine on OpenStreetMap for cars, bikes, walking and transit, used by ride and delivery apps for routes, travel times and maps.

repos.name: GraphHopper
repos.role: Routing engine on OpenStreetMap that delivery and fleet apps use for routes, travel times and route planning.

repos.name: Fleetbase
repos.role: Self-hosted delivery and logistics platform with order, driver and shop apps, used to run on-demand food and parcel delivery.

repos.name: TastyIgniter
repos.role: Self-hosted restaurant system for online food orders and table reservations.

repos.name: Duffel API (JavaScript)

repos.name: QloApps

repos.name: OpenTripPlanner
